scripts.dev:documents: npm --prefix ../functions run build && concurrently -k -n emulators,web "npm run emulator:start:full" "wait-on tcp:9099 tcp:8080 tcp:5001 && npm run dev:test"
scripts.dev:documents:mobile:internal: npm --prefix ../functions run build && concurrently -k -n emulators,web "npm run emulator:start:full" "wait-on tcp:9099 tcp:8080 tcp:5001 && npm run dev:test:mobile"
scripts.build: npm run test:auth && vue-tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-rertm --only firestore "vitest run src/__tests__/firestore.rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:documents:emulator: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-rertm --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run src/__tests__/documents.emulator.test.ts"
scripts.verify:e2e:list: E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm exec --no -- e2e list
scripts.verify:e2e:smoke: E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm exec --no -- e2e run verification/tests/smoke.e2e.ts --output .e2e/proof/doctor --trace on --video
scripts.verify:e2e:mobile-news: E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm exec --no -- e2e run verification/tests/mobile-news.e2e.ts --output .e2e/proof/mobile-news --trace on --video
scripts.verify:e2e:guide: E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm exec --no -- e2e guide
scripts.verify:e2e:browser-install: E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm exec --no -- e2e-web install chromium
